title: Book Three · Chapter 122: The Old Man's Voice
story:
On the Friday before his birthday, Ronan's class reads a short play.

Kai is a young traveller. Ronan is an old man beside a road. The teacher gives each of them a page.

“I can be old,” Kai says.

“Wait your turn,” Ronan answers.

They put two chairs at the front. Kai carries his school bag and walks between them.

“Which way to the market?” he reads.

Ronan looks at his page. The old man cannot hear very well. He lowers the page and faces Kai.

“A basket?”

“The market.”

“I haven't got a basket.”

A few students laugh. Kai lifts his voice.

“The market!”

Ronan puts a hand beside his ear.

“No need to shout. It is just behind you.”

Kai turns toward the board. For a moment, he is facing a large maths question.

“An expensive market,” he says quietly.

The class laughs harder. The teacher smiles, then points to the page.

“Back to the play.”

They start the next part. Kai loses his place after a long answer. Ronan waits, then points to the first word of his line.

Kai finds it and carries on. This time, he looks up before he speaks.

The play ends with the traveller beside the wrong house. Ronan uses his old voice once more and points him toward the chairs.

When they sit down, Anna leans toward him.

“Seventeen tomorrow. Very old already.”

“I may need the chair.”

She smiles and passes his pencil back.

After the lesson, another boy asks Ronan to say the basket line again. He does, but only once. Kai stands beside him and gives the young traveller's answer.

At lunch, they talk about Saturday's football. Kai can meet at ten in the park. His friend is bringing two more boys.

Anna has a run with Lin first. She can come to the field afterward.

“I will find the loud old man,” she says.

“I am quieter outside school.”

Kai looks at her. “He isn't.”

Ronan puts a piece of bread in his mouth before he can answer. Anna laughs and opens her lunch box.

That afternoon, Ronan takes the play sheet home. He shows Mum the first two lines while she rests from her sewing.

Dad hears the old voice from the kitchen.

“Who has come in?”

Mum points to Ronan. He lifts his hand beside his ear again, and Dad brings his cup through the door to hear the answer.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

play＝戏剧、剧本；traveller＝旅人；lose one's place＝读着读着找不到当前行；carry on＝继续。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan和Kai各演谁？Kai找不到台词时，Ronan怎样帮忙？
2. 本章Ronan已满十七岁了吗？明天的见面安排是什么？

## 读句子

**Kai finds it and carries on.**

拆开看：Kai / finds it / and carries on.

Kai／找到那句台词／接着继续表演。
